card.interpretation: A medium working mining town on a slope, with the mine entrance at the bottom and minecart rails running down to it. Style is rustic and practical. The town is the mine's support: homes, a smelter, an assay office, a tavern and storage, centred on a cart station and a headframe. No backstory given.
